thread:
emma (Product): Quick sync — ACME Finance asked for a secure private inference setup with p99 < 120ms for chat (avg ~80 tokens). They want a decision and a rollout plan in 3 weeks; need cross-team tradeoffs.

chao (Eng Runtime): Clarifying q: 120ms p99 for single-request latency or end-to-end streaming? Which model size?

emma (Product): Single-request completion p99. They mentioned a 7B-class model (customer preference), and they emphasized deterministic quantization results.

linda (Infra PM): Procurement note: A100 lead times are ~8 wks for our usual vendors. If they need on-prem racks we should flag that immediately. Alternative is to offer a Dedicated reserved pool while we prep on-prem.

nate (Security): Security requirements noted: FIPS KMS, SOC2 artifacts, and an external pentest. Pentest scheduling is 4-6 weeks. HSM integration for FIPS will add config/ops work.

simon (Eng): From runtime side: 7B quantized on A100 can hit ~120ms p99 for ~80 tokens if we avoid batching and keep KV cache warm. Deterministic behavior across quantized kernels is nontrivial — we'll need a quant-validation pipeline.

emma (Product): So tradeoffs look like: Option A = Dedicated pilot (fast, less infra lift) + contractual security controls. Option B = full on-prem with HSM + pentest (meets security fully but slips timeline). Which path gives the customer a credible 3-week pilot?

chao (Eng Runtime): Proposal: phased approach. Phase 1 (3 weeks): Dedicated pilot on our infra with KMS proxy to approximate FIPS at-rest, run latency & accuracy tests, quick quant-validation run. Phase 2 (post-pentest): deliver on-prem bundle/HSM + full determinism guarantees.

linda (Infra PM): I can commit to standing up Dedicated pilot capacity if customer signs a timeboxed commitment. Procurement for HW expedited only if they commit to on-prem.

nate (Security): We'll start pentest vendor outreach and draft a scoping checklist. Need product to lock acceptance criteria for us to scope the pentest properly.

emma (Product): Draft acceptance criteria (please comment/edit):
- latency: p99 <= 120ms on 80-token completions
- throughput: sustain >= 40 qps for pilot
- security: FIPS-compatible KMS or HSM for on-prem; audit logs and SOC2 artifacts
- determinism: quantized model accuracy delta <= 1% on customer's eval set
- rollback: automatic fallback to hosted model variant if p99 > 150ms for >5m

simon (Eng): Add runbook item: fallback route + alert to SRE and product with automatic throttling. Also we should include a small smoke harness: `python tools/latency_check.py --model test --qps 10 --tokens 80`

ops-bot: Created ticket #2345: procurement-expedite-request (assigned to @linda).

emma (Product): Can each owner react with 👍 if they accept the phased plan and the acceptance criteria? Need firm commitments by EOD Friday so we can present to the customer.

chao (Eng Runtime): 👍 — will own runtime spike and quant-validation.

linda (Infra PM): 👍 — will reserve pilot capacity; procurement contingent on signed MSA.

nate (Security): 👍 — starting pentest outreach and checklist draft.

simon (Eng): 👍 — will add smoke harness and fallback implementation spike.

emma (Product): Great — I'll consolidate and update the customer-facing timeline. If anyone surfaces blockers before EOD pls ping me directly. :calendar:
